pattern.deadline_window: Abstract early-to-mid May, full paper 2-7 days later, 23:59 AoE (2024: May 15/22; 2025: May 11/15; 2026: May 4/6). Trend is drifting earlier.
pattern.notification_month: Late September (2024: Sep 25/26; 2025: Sep 18; 2026: Sep 24). Reviews released late July with a ~1-week author discussion.
pattern.conference_month: Early-to-mid December, Sun/Tue through Sat/Sun (2024: Dec 10-15; 2025: Dec 2-7; 2026: Dec 6-12).
pattern.location_rotation: Vancouver 2024 -> San Diego + Mexico City 2025 -> Sydney (main) + Atlanta and Paris satellites 2026 -> Europe 2027 (city not announced) -> Western United States 2028 (official Future Meetings page). Multi-site since 2025.
pattern.review_process: Double-blind on OpenReview with mandatory reciprocal reviewing; ~3-5 reviews, reviews released late July, one-week author-reviewer discussion, then reviewer/AC discussion and SAC calibration; decisions late September. No summary-reject phase.
pattern.dual_submission: Main Track Handbook: 'The reviewing process will treat any other archival submission by an overlapping set of authors as prior work (dual submissions to nonarchival workshops are permitted).' It also 'explicitly prohibit[s] submitting work to NeurIPS and then later submitting the same work to another archival venue while it is still under review at NeurIPS.'
pattern.arxiv_policy: Main Track Handbook: 'The existence of non-anonymous preprints (on arXiv or other online repositories, personal websites, social media) will not result in rejection.' But 'aggressive advertising of papers under submission may be deemed a violation.'
pattern.resubmission_tips: Decisions land ~Sep 18-25, which is after the AAAI abstract deadline (late July) but before the AISTATS full-paper deadline (early Oct) and ICLR (late Sep/early Oct); a NeurIPS reject can go to AISTATS/ICLR within 1-2 weeks or to ICML in late January.

pattern.arxiv_policy: The COLM 2026 CFP does not state an explicit preprint policy beyond double-blind submission (it references arXiv only for its LLM-use policy). Posting to arXiv has been common practice among COLM submitters; treat as permitted but unverified.
pattern.resubmission_tips: COLM's late-March deadline is 2 months after ICML (and ~3 weeks after ICML reviews are released), so ICML papers cannot be dual-submitted - they must be withdrawn from ICML first. COLM decisions (early July) arrive ~3 weeks before the AAAI abstract deadline.

pattern.deadline_window: Abstract late Feb / early Mar, paper ~1 week later (or same day), 23:59 AoE (2025: Feb 21/28; 2026: Mar 5/5 after the abstract deadline was moved from Mar 1).
pattern.notification_month: Early May (2025: May 9; 2026: May 5). Author response phase ~mid-April (Apr 11-17 in 2026). Camera-ready mid-July.
pattern.conference_month: August, 4-5 days (2025: Aug 5-9 Edmonton; 2026: Aug 15-18 Montreal; 2027: early Aug at Brown + late Aug in Odense).
pattern.location_rotation: Amherst 2024 -> Edmonton 2025 -> Montreal 2026 -> 2027 two sites: Brown University (Providence, USA, early Aug) and Odense, Denmark (late Aug, joint with EWRL). Organizers say 2028 will be a single location outside North America.
pattern.review_process: Papers are submitted to the Reinforcement Learning Journal (RLJ) and presented at RLC; double-blind on OpenReview with review (~2 weeks), review-adjustment, author response phase (~1 week), and AC decision; accepted papers are published in RLJ. Paper bidding by reviewers happens the week after the deadline.
pattern.dual_submission: RLC/RLJ 2026 CFP: 'Authors should not submit papers that are substantially similar to versions that have been published, accepted for publication, or submitted in parallel to other conferences or journals.' However 'Authors may submit substantially similar versions to workshops ... Notably, dual-submission with RLDM is explicitly allowed.'
pattern.arxiv_policy: RLC/RLJ 2026 CFP: authors 'may publish substantially similar versions on arXiv'.
pattern.resubmission_tips: RLC's early-March deadline is 5 weeks after ICML and 1 week after UAI; RLC decisions (early May) arrive on/just after the NeurIPS abstract deadline, so an RLC reject cannot go to NeurIPS the same cycle - AAAI (late July) or ICLR (late Sep) are the next stops.
